mapper.select: select doc::text as doc from tenant_state where tenant_id = #{tid}
select calls::bigint as calls, (tin + tout)::bigint as tok from ai_usage where tenant_id = #{tid} and day = #{day}::date

select coalesce((select sum(amount) from led_receipt where tenant_id = #{tid} and status = 'paid' and (paid_at at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')::date = #{day}::date), 0) - coalesce((select sum(amount) from led_refund where tenant_id = #{tid} and status = 'done' and (coalesce(done_at, at) at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')::date = #{day}::date), 0)
select 1 from user_totp where user_id = #{uid}::uuid and on_at is not null and updated_at > now() - interval '10 minutes'
mapper.update: update tenant_state set doc = jsonb_set(jsonb_set(doc, '{org}', coalesce(doc->'org', '{}'::jsonb)), '{org,grp}', coalesce(doc->'org'->'grp', '{}'::jsonb) || jsonb_build_object(#{key}, #{value}::jsonb)), rev = rev + 1, updated_at = now() where tenant_id = #{tid}
update tenant_state set doc = #{doc}::jsonb, rev = rev + 1, bytes = octet_length(#{doc}), updated_at = now() where tenant_id = #{tid}
